shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md
printf '\\n--- lore commands ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null || true
printf '\\n--- candidate spec dirs ---\\n'
find specs -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'spec.md' -print | sort
printf '\\n--- package ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' package.json
printf '\\n--- registry ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/types/ai.ts
printf '\\n--- nearby tool tests ---\\n'
rg -n \"ToolRegistry|register\\(|tool call|toolCall|MockProvider|class .*Provider\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '\\n--- orchestrator test relevant ---\\n'
rg -n -C 6 \"tool|processMessage\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '1,320p'
printf '\\n--- logger ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' src/shared/logger.ts
printf '\\n--- jest config ---\\n'
cat jest.config.js"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,110p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '367,560p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,280p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,160p' src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts
rg -n \"validated by.*acceptance|specs/.*#\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -40
rg -n \"spec:\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' --glob '*.ts' | head -80"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+#[0-9]+\" src scripts --glob '*.test.ts' | head -80
rg -n \"require-spec-link|spec anchor|ordinal\" eslint.config.mjs scripts specs | head -100
sed -n '1,120p' specs/hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '115,145p' eslint.config.mjs
rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -20
rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -50"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md | sed -n '1,360p'
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs --check origin/main"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(tools): define input validation acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count '@{upstream}...HEAD'"
